title: Near-identity data encoding
locator: Data-encoding trainability analysis; the product-encoder derivative below is derived explicitly here
scope: analytical special case; no universal encoding guarantee
use_case: Bounded classical features and tunable weak quantum embeddings
assumptions: Bounded features $|x_i|\leq1$; $E_\epsilon(x)=\bigotimes_i R_y(\epsilon x_i)$; reference trainable angles $\theta_i=\pi/2$; normalized mean-Z objective.
baseline: Use encoding scale 1 instead of encoding_scale, keeping the bounded features and trainable reference identical.
implementation_status: analytically checked product-encoder special case; bounded features required

title: Identity-block initialization
use_case: Deeper variational models with a useful reference and shallow identity blocks
assumptions: Each block has independent forward/backward parameters initialized to equal values; invert gate order and angles exactly. Preserve shallow effective causal cones and a nonzero state-observable commutator.
baseline: Independently randomize forward and inverse branches instead of matching their initial values.
implementation_status: analytically checked shallow-block special case; independent copies; initialization only

title: Quantum natural gradient descent
locator: Fubini-Study geometry and natural-gradient update; metric approximation discussion
scope: geometric optimization method; no general barren-plateau avoidance guarantee
use_case: Ill-conditioned quantum-state parameterizations with resolvable gradients
assumptions: Differentiable normalized pure state; consistently defined Fubini-Study metric; regularization or a pseudoinverse for singular directions; gradient and metric estimation budgets must be affordable.
baseline: Euclidean gradient descent; same circuit, objective, initialization, learning rate and gradient estimator. QNG adds separately counted exact metric state evaluations.
implementation_status: optimizer companion; exact-simulator metric; not a proven general plateau remedy

title: Local losses and bounded causal cones
use_case: Quantum autoencoders and local state preparation
assumptions: Local observable; logarithmic alternating-layer depth; independent local 2-design blocks; nonvanishing input-dependent purity factors.
baseline: Global all-zero infidelity versus its local surrogate; same zero set.

title: Quantum convolutional neural networks
locator: Theorem 1 and Corollary 1; Theorem 2 for pooling-only networks
use_case: Classification and compression of structured quantum states
assumptions: Independent local 2-design convolution blocks; the specified pooling channel; a nontrivial output observable and non-exponentially-small data-dependent factors.
baseline: Replace the structured architecture with depth-configured full-register Haar sweeps and the same input and observable. Gate counts differ and must be compared; a short control need not exhibit a plateau.
implementation_status: restricted demonstration; inspect guide before transferring the published guarantee

title: Observable-aware Gaussian mixture initialization

title: Spatially correlated parameters
use_case: Permutation-aligned learning targets and tied quantum feature blocks
assumptions: Correlation pattern and observable must match the construction. Parameter tying alone gives no general lower bound; resource cost can grow exponentially in some examples.
baseline: Independent angles versus one spatially shared angle.

title: Short-time constrained Hamiltonian ansatz
use_case: Physics-informed QML with a known local generator and reference state
assumptions: Local generators and observable; reference commutator $g=|\mathrm{Tr}(\rho_0[H^{(m)},O])|=\Theta(1)$; nonnegative total evolution time below the theorem threshold $\tau_0=\Theta(1/n)$.
baseline: Same circuit and task, uniformly initialized parameters.
implementation_status: restricted demonstration; inspect guide before transferring the published guarantee

title: Fixed low-excitation sectors
use_case: Single-particle features and fixed-particle quantum data
assumptions: Weight-preserving circuit; reference in weight-k sector; sufficiently mixed ensemble within the relevant sector; suitable measurement and data factors. Fixed k is essential to the dimension argument.
baseline: Add nonconserving Y rotations to the same excitation-preserving circuit; compare task quality and leakage as well as gradients.
implementation_status: restricted demonstration; inspect guide before transferring the published guarantee

title: Permutation-equivariant quantum models
use_case: Permutation-invariant quantum data and unordered feature sets
assumptions: Full S_n-equivariant generators; compatible measurement; input projection onto relevant representation sectors must not be exponentially weak; use the published mixing/ensemble assumptions.
baseline: Replace collective parameters with site/pair-dependent angles, breaking full permutation equivariance.
implementation_status: restricted demonstration; inspect guide before transferring the published guarantee

assumptions: Local random gates; specified local non-unital noise; local output observables. Bounds depend on distance from output; useful input information and earlier gradients can still be lost.

title: Local-moment MMD objectives
locator: Implicit-loss analysis and kernel bodyness discussion
use_case: Sample-based generative learning of selected local statistics
assumptions: An implicit sample loss; significant low-body kernel contributions; shallow compatible circuit and nonvanishing data-dependent factors. Full-distribution identification needs a richer kernel.
baseline: Use the global delta kernel, whose MMD squared equals the full probability-vector squared distance to the same independent-bit target. It distinguishes more distributions but can concentrate.
implementation_status: restricted demonstration; inspect guide before transferring the published guarantee
